judged_text: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy calls host.destroy on the nil returned by the id lookup when the record is already gone, raising NoMethodError. Two admins deleting the same host (or a double-submit racing the first DELETE) makes the second request return a 500 instead of success_json, surfacing an error popup in the admin UI for an operation that actually succeeded.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb#destroy`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `host.destroy`. If the record is already deleted (or the id is invalid), `host` will be `nil` and `nil.destroy` will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500 instead of returning `success_json`. This matches the described race/double-delete scenario and is directly verifiable from the diff.
